description:
About us

Artefact is a data and AI services company with around 2,500 people across 36 offices. We are part of Anthropic's Claude Partner Network and have rolled out Claude across our own organization, so our advice to clients comes from running it ourselves first.

DeployCo is Artefact's team dedicated to deploying Claude at scale inside enterprises. It works through three levers. Deployment and adoption gets organizations from a few early adopters to company-wide use. Process reimagination redesigns core workflows around agentic AI. Agent production ships working agents into client systems. Forward Deployed Engineers are the builders behind the third lever and the technical backbone of the other two.

The role

As an FDE you join a client's own AI or engineering team as a builder, not an advisor. You design, code, and ship production-grade Claude solutions directly inside their stack, following their conventions, repositories, and CI. You also leave the capability behind, so that when the engagement ends the client's engineers can extend and maintain what was built without us.
The work ranges from short, intense engagements, like standing up a governed Claude Code deployment in a few weeks, to longer embeds where you become the technical anchor of a multi-agent portfolio and a larger Artefact pod grows around you. This is a senior role, and we expect you to own technical direction on an engagement from the first week.

What you'll do

  • Build production agents. Design and deploy Claude-based agents and workflows that run in production, with the engineering standards that implies. That means tests, error handling, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Connect Claude to enterprise systems. Build custom MCP servers and connectors to business applications and data sources, enforcing the client's own access rules. This includes permissions, traceability, and segregation of rights.
  • Engineer the context layer. Contribute to Artefact's context platform approach, including deterministic authentication before data reaches the model, user-level context injection, and observability for token spend and security.
  • Deploy and govern Claude Code. Set up SSO and role-based access, managed settings, approved MCP servers and plugin marketplaces, permission modes, sandboxing, and OpenTelemetry-based usage monitoring. Help clients choose between deployment options (Team, Enterprise, cloud providers, gateways) based on security, data residency, and cost.
  • Build reusable skills. Turn client workflows into Claude Skills and shared skills libraries that teams can find, reuse, and build on.
  • Enable client engineers. Pair program, review code, document patterns, and deliver hands-on Claude Code training and labs, sometimes to cohorts of dozens of developers and sometimes to CTOs and engineering leaders.
  • Feed the product loop. Capture deployment pitfalls and product feedback from the field and share it with Anthropic through our partnership.

What you bring

  • Senior-level experience in software engineering or data science, with production systems you have shipped and operated
  • Recent, hands-on work with the GenAI stack, going beyond prototypes. This includes tool use, agent design, retrieval, evaluation, and prompt and context engineering.
  • Demonstrated depth with Claude in particular, such as Claude Code, the Claude API, Skills, or MCP, and a point of view on how the stack is evolving
  • Strong Python or TypeScript, and solid grounding in enterprise integration, including APIs, identity and access management (SSO, OAuth, SCIM), and cloud platforms
  • Confidence in client-facing settings, explaining technical trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders, and running a workshop when needed
  • Fluent in German and English 

Nice to have

  • Anthropic certification (Claude Certified Developer or Architect) is welcome but not expected, since it is usually only available through a partner company. We support you in earning it once you join.
  • Experience building and securing MCP servers
  • Background in security, observability (OpenTelemetry), or FinOps for AI workloads
  • Experience in regulated industries such as banking, asset management, or pharma
  • A track record of teaching or technical training

What we offer

  • Direct work with Anthropic's partner and applied AI teams, including co-delivered labs
  • Varied, high-impact engagements across EMEA in finance, retail, industry, and consumer goods
  • A clear path from FDE to technical anchor of a full AI delivery pod
  • Certification support and dedicated learning time

Come as you are!

title: Full Stack Engineer (.NET + Front-End)
description: Full Stack Engineer (.NET + Front-End) — NetSpeek NetSpeek is the agentic control plane for enterprise physical infrastructure . We govern how AI agents reason about, decide on, and execute actions across enterprise endpoints. Our reasoning and execution layer — Lena — sits in customer production environments, where reliability, observability, and auditability are non-negotiable. TThe Full Stack Engineer ships features end-to-end across the .NET backbone, the React surfaces, and the operator workflows on top of Lena. You'll move across the stack daily. What you'll work on Designing and shipping .NET 6+ backend services that mediate between AI reasoning, device adapters, and operator surfaces. Building React surfaces that present Lena's signal — including uncertainty shape, not just confidence numbers. Owning the REST API design between backend and frontend (and Lena's Python services). Driving operator UX decisions in partnership with product, with attention to the workflows operators run dozens of times a day. You're a fit if You have 5+ years of .NET / C# backend experience, with hands-on production work in .NET 6 or newer. You have 3+ years of React (or comparable modern framework) experience. You've shipped end-to-end features that touched both backend and frontend in the same project. You've designed and shipped production REST APIs in a distributed SaaS environment. You have hands-on production experience with AWS (preferred), Azure, or GCP. You probably aren't a fit if You're a backend-only engineer who treats the UI as someone else's problem. You're a frontend-only engineer who treats the API as a given. You haven't worked in environments where AI changes the contract between layers.. How to apply We prefer applications through our hiring site: https://build.netspeek.ai/roles/full-stack-engineer There are three paths there, and we prioritize them in this order: 1. Incident Lab / Case Study —work through a real scenario for this role and send your reasoning with the application. Read first. The scenario gives us the most signal on how you actually think. 2. Field Note —a single written take instead of the scenario. Read second. Faster than the lab, still a strong signal. 3. Standard application —resume and the basics through the site's apply form. Read third. Applying directly through Workable below also works, and we'll still read it. The site's three paths exist because they give us better context for the read. Either path is read by a human on our hiring team. No AI scoring, no auto-rejection. Read the Engineering Handbook and How We Evaluate before applying. After an offer We run standard pre-employment checks before your start date: identity verification, right-to-work confirmation, employment verification, and (where lawful and role-relevant) a criminal record check. We don't run credit checks or online reputation scoring. Requirements Must-have Strong backend engineering experience in .NET / C#, with hands-on production work in modern .NET (6+, not legacy Framework only). Frontend development experience with modern React (or comparable framework such as Next.js, Vue, or Svelte). API design experience for distributed SaaS systems; you have designed and shipped production REST APIs. Cloud-native application development with AWS preferred (Azure or GCP also welcome). Strong debugging and systems thinking. Strong signal Real-time systems or orchestration platform experience. Enterprise SaaS architecture familiarity. Exposure to AI-integrated applications (you do not need to be the AI engineer, but you should be comfortable working alongside one). Startup or scale-up environment experience. Observability and operational tooling familiarity. Benefits We are growth-stage and fully remote, not late-stage. We invest in the work, the tools, and the people, not the manifesto. What that looks like in practice: Flexible / unlimited time off Health insurance Equity participation, discussed at offer Fully remote Architectural ownership of work that ships to real enterprise customers Direct working relationships with the people setting platform strategy A growth-stage platform where the decisions you make in your first year shape the product for years AI-assisted tooling licensed by NetSpeek (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or comparable)
